parsed.explanation: Identity (3) is essential to primewise invariance, but the write-up explicitly omits its proof. The later audit checks only (0,b), (a,a), and (0,0), then relies again on identity (3) for the general case. A sentence suffices: assuming a≤b, a number divides both a,b iff it divides both a,b−a, so gcd(a,b)=gcd(a,b−a), including zero and equal cases. The existing associativity argument then preserves the full exponent-vector gcd.
